item_name: Rothco Security Low Profile Insignia Mesh Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Security Low Profile Insignia Mesh Cap is the perfect hat to wear while on the job. Featuring silver "SECURITY" text prominently embroidered on the front 2 panels, this cap showcases your public safety role with pride. The durable poly-cotton mesh construction ensures long-lasting use, while the air mesh front panel provides optimal airflow, keeping you cool and comfortable during your shift. 4 reinforced vent holes further enhance breathability, making this cap ideal for warm weather or intense activity.
